findings.text: the map's content is unguarded — no test reads it and the crew/reports directory is not a git repository (rev-parse refuses), so a later edit to a verdict or a citation can silently contradict the tree it describes; the same weakness was recorded for docs/evidence/archive/ in the review of r-20260914T094316532378 and this record is weaker still because it lacks even git history.

the section heading reads "§17 — runtime gate (7 rows)" while the table below it delivers 6 rows and the report's own count line and manifest both say 6, a residual of the earlier 18-count miscount the report itself describes; a reader could mistake it for a dropped row.

justifications.durability: nothing reads this record — no test asserts over the crew/reports directory (the only test references to that path touch review-staging JSON at tests/test_review_composition.py:205 and a browser probe, not this map) and the directory has no git repository, so an edited verdict or a citation pointing at a line that no longer exists fails nothing.
justifications.evidence: independently reproduced against the base — every sampled citation resolved to its claimed content (reckon/cli.py:966 and :1297 the two --wave surfaces, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2373 _resolved_wave_id with the call at :2768 and the pointer field at :2833, reckon/crew/runs.py:1218-1261 watch-seat trio with no callers for replace_stale_watch_seat, reckon/crew/recovery.py:280 the token budget and :2579 the exported spend fields, reckon/crew/metering.py:233 the named-exclusion is_durable, reckon/_backends.py:464 the retry discriminator), all six absence greps reproduced empty (wave in reckon/crew/ticker.py, seal, worker message, soft threshold, wave in promotion/ledger, rendered overrun), the plan tables count 11+6=17, and every cited test line resolves and matches the report's description.
justifications.fit: the map follows the reuse-map idiom of its precedent crew/reports/display-reuse-map.md, uses a settled satisfied/partial/absent verdict vocabulary and per-section write-path tables with asserting tests beside each source, and introduces no plan, sprint or ticket label into the filename or content; it is docked for internal inconsistencies — the §17 heading names 7 rows while delivering 6, and the retracted-mechanism paragraph at crew-observability-truth.html:827 is attributed to the fourth row when it sits in the third row's cell.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the report maps all 17 measure rows verified in the plan tables at the base revision (docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html:650-665 spans §13's 11 rows, :820-832 §17's 6), one row per measure row with a satisfied/partial/absent verdict, a file:line citation on every satisfied and partial row, the 17-count stated explicitly when found, and a proposed exclusive write-path set per section with the asserting test files named beside each source, meeting every clause of the done-when.
justifications.scope_discipline: the node wrote exactly one path, its declared write path /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/display-truth-reuse-wave-soft-limit.md, made no commit because that directory is not a git repository, and said so in the manifest rather than claiming or inventing one.
